intro.value: Lab of Dr Marcus Kaiser and his team as part of the Precision Imaging research group. We are working on the simulation of the dynamics and development of neural networks using Neuroinformatics and network analysis tools. We aim to understand the link between structure and dynamics (e.g. for schizophrenia, depression, dementia or other network diseases) and to use non-invasive brain stimulation (focused ultrasound neuromodulation) to change connectomes in order to improve brain function. We also lead Neuroinformatics UK representing more than 600 researchers in the fields of neuroinformatics and computational neuroscience.
